scripts.build:zig: bash servers/zig/build-assets.sh && cd servers/zig && ${ZIG_BIN:-zig} build-exe -O ReleaseFast -fstrip src/main.zig -femit-bin=snek-zig --cache-dir .zig-cache --global-cache-dir .zig-global-cache
scripts.check: npm run check:zig && npm run test:transport && npm run test:snapshot && npm run test:input
scripts.check:zig: bash servers/zig/build-assets.sh && cd servers/zig && ${ZIG_BIN:-zig} fmt --check src/*.zig && ${ZIG_BIN:-zig} test src/main.zig --cache-dir .zig-cache --global-cache-dir .zig-global-cache
scripts.bench:snapshot: cd servers/zig && zig run -O ReleaseFast --cache-dir .zig-cache --global-cache-dir .zig-global-cache bench_snapshot.zig
scripts.bench:tick-scratch: cd servers/zig && zig run -O ReleaseFast --cache-dir .zig-cache --global-cache-dir .zig-global-cache bench_tick_scratch.zig
scripts.bench:lobby-reap: cd servers/zig && zig run -O ReleaseFast --cache-dir .zig-cache --global-cache-dir .zig-global-cache bench_lobby_reap.zig
